verdict.rationale: Exa's pricing docs list a first-party capability for "scheduled searches that surface new events on the web" (exa-docs-10). Websets results can also be delivered asynchronously via webhooks or HTTP callbacks (exa-docs-21, exa-docs-53), which fits a recurring-job workflow. The scheduling evidence is a single thin pricing-page line rather than in-depth documentation. missing for 10: documentation of how to create or configure a schedule (cadence, cron, API endpoints), scheduling of general workflows or agent runs beyond searches, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
